searchText: On last ACD, there were questions about if other teams aside from Uniswap would benefit from EIP-1153: Arbitrum just left a note saying they would as well: https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eip-1153-transient-storage-opcodes/553/47?u=fredlacs <dankrad> Question on 3607: It is currently marked as "in review". However I remember that we discussed that we actually treat it as if the behaviour should *always* have been like this, i.e. clients just fix it whenever. Should it not then be marked as final? Or should we put it on the agenda again and if everyone agrees that this is how we define correct behaviour, mark it as final? <dankrad> Also, have teams implemented it? Yes, geth has implemented it: https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/pull/23303 <dankrad> So it should probably be marked as final then? Yes, you'll just have to make a PR to move to last call then after the 2 week period, make a PR marking it final <timbeiko> someone asked about this recently and I believe all teams had it implemented <dankrad> @lightclient: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/4657

excerpts.author: timbeiko
excerpts.content: On last ACD, there were questions about if other teams aside from Uniswap would benefit from EIP-1153: Arbitrum just left a note saying they would as well: https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eip-1153-transient-storage-opcodes/553/47?u=fredlacs

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content:
<dankrad> Question on 3607: It is currently marked as "in review". However I remember that we discussed that we actually treat it as if the behaviour should *always* have been like this, i.e. clients just fix it whenever.
Should it not then be marked as final? Or should we put it on the agenda again and if everyone agrees that this is how we define correct behaviour, mark it as final?

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <dankrad> So it should probably be marked as final then?

excerpts.author: lightclient
excerpts.content: Yes, you'll just have to make a PR to move to last call then after the 2 week period, make a PR marking it final

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <timbeiko> someone asked about this recently and I believe all teams had it implemented
